## What changed

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

State how you proved the change on the real artifact: the command you ran, the endpoint you called, or the screen you drove.

## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` is green.
- [ ] `just test` is green.
- [ ] The change is verified on the real artifact.
- [ ] Commits are signed.
- [ ] No secrets or machine-specific paths are included.
- [ ] Docs and `docs/manifest.json` are updated when behavior changed.
